headline: UI / UX Designer
intro: I build interfaces that stay out of the player's way: menus, HUDs, dialogue and quest flows, and the systems behind them. Several of these put the UI inside the game world rather than on top of it. These are the projects where interface work led.

bullets: Designed and built the full UI, including the leaderboard system
Kept the interface legible against a fast-moving first-person game
Shipped it inside a browser-based performance budget
Made the main menu a 3D space where UI and world occupy the same scene
Built 2D UI tooling so interface elements feel physically present
Integrated puzzle interactions directly into world geometry
Wrote a custom UI line renderer to drive a bespoke in-game graph
Designed an upgrade system whose options read clearly mid-run
Surfaced enemy and trap state so players can plan their next placement
Built the entire UI within a one-week game jam
Developed in-house dialogue and quest systems, plus an in-game manual
Kept the flows readable with no dedicated UI artist on the team
Created the menu and pause-menu UI for a workstation-driven game
Built a dialogue system timed against recorded voice acting
Designed diegetic monitor screens the player reads as in-world tools
Built a player customiser and a save system that persists room decoration
Made the build mobile-compatible, adapting input and layout for touch
Designed the password-creator mini game as a self-contained interaction
